title: Support for displaying Japanese characters in a game created with RPG Maker XP on Steam

posts.author: Octopus26
posts.body:
Greetings. I’m seeking support for displaying Japanese characters in a game created with RPG Maker XP on Steam.
I tried replacing the RGSS104E.dll file with the RGSS104J.dll file from the Japanese trial version in the game folder to enable Japanese character support. This modification worked, but I was informed that it might violate the End User License Agreement (EULA).
Could you please clarify whether this modification actually violates the license agreement? If so, is there a legitimate way to add Japanese character rendering support to the Steam version of RPG Maker XP?
Any guidance or advice you can provide on this matter would be greatly appreciated. My goal is to develop a game in Japanese while staying in compliance with the terms of the license.
Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to your response.

posts.author: AkiraKotatsuhime
posts.body:
At first: It should be no problem for RGSS to display 日本語 ingame usually with a normal 102E or 104E, it confuses me you had to swap that out. But for some unknown reason the RGSS Player straight-up refuses to display the old default JP Windows fonts (MS Gothic, MS Mincho) if the computer is not set to the language entirely while locale-emulation rather doesn't help. So far, my experience with this.
Now that aside, did the person informing you it could violate terms had all information necessary to tell you that? Hard to consider what you did as a modification at all, it still is an official unchanged DLL of RPGXP you're referencing and adding to the game, so I don't see any problem if the contract doesn't state some stuff like you are only allowed to use that one or that version or file with specific suffix.
The best way for getting help with things in legal-topics may be to contact official support directly with an e-mail. The people knowing best about this are unlikely to be encountered here.
～炬燵あ

I contacted official technical support, but they replied that they no longer support RPG Maker XP, so I decided to ask here.
My computer is running a fully Japanese version of Windows, but the standard RGSS still doesn't display the MS Gothic font correctly. I tried replacing the standard font with another Japanese one, and it worked! Now I can use the standard RGSS, simply by changing the font. Thank you for your help!
